title: Web service depends Wifi connection
symptom: The xDrip Web Service at http://127.0.0.1:17580/sgv.json returns a '_Temporary unavailable or under maintenance_' error page when the Android phone is not connected to any Wifi network.
cause: The issue was caused by browser behavior: when wifi/data is off, the browser shows an unavailable page, but the web service actually still responds. Additionally, Fitbit companion apps require an internet connection to initiate connections.
fix: No fix was provided; the user gave up on this method for watch integration.
evidence_quote: Actually browser behavior made me wrong, cause returns a _webservice unavailable page_ when wifi (and optionally) data is off. On a reload/refresh, browser identifies that phone is offline. Using http request tool, the web service still responds.
